bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 4, 5, 6, 7. LOPE DE LUNA is a Scone trained debutant who has trialed once at Tamworth since a long spell. He did enough in that trial to be treated with respect in this class at his first start on his home track. SUMMER FORCE is another first starter who must be considered as suitably placed on debut here. She won her Tamworth trial since a spell and she has ability. HIGHLAND DANCER was beaten at very short odds when she was resuming at Quirindi. She wasn't however disgraced and she will present race-fitter over the same journey today. YEAH BUDDY begins his first campaign since a stable change after trialing twelve days ago at Tamworth. This short trip should be suitable first up. GAY TARANTELLA  must be forgiven for an unplaced debut effort at Wellington when she struck traffic problems. She resumes today after a dominant trial effort at her Tamworth home base and she's now ready to fire first up.

raceTips.comment: Yeah Buddy is now trained here and has trialled well. He has been consistent to date without breaking through and strikes a good race to do so, hence the market support. Highland Dancer went around odds-on when resuming and was disappointing on face value. I'm not ready to write her off yet and wouldn't be surprised to see sharp improvement. Gay Tarantella resumes for a second prep and looked good winning a recent trial by a big margin. Summer Force has been trialling well in readiness for her debut.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 4, 8, 9, 11. SIR BOOM A LOT handed in a gallant front-running effort here at home over this distance on debut last start and natural improvement can now be expected. EXCELS finished unplaced at short odds here first up but a post-race issue was detected and the addition of a tongue-tie is highly significant this afternoon.  RALLET faces the starter for the first time after winning his lead-up trial on the Beaumont track at Newcastle. He's more than  ready to now make his debut. DORSET LASS who presents on debut after trialing at Tamworth since her spell and LONG LIVE who has trialed at Newcastle on the Beaumont track since there were excuses for an unplaced first up Quirindi effort, are also both in the mix!

raceTips.comment: Love You Anyway is a long time maiden but I can't help but be enticed by the price on offer. Regular rider, suitable distance and best efforts are seemingly good enough to finally break through. Rallet has trialled well and certainly strikes a winnable maiden to debut in. Sir Boom A Lot was solid on debut and will have derived good benefit from the experience. Dorset Lass is another local debutant who has been trialling well.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 3, 4, 8. FEAZABEEL was making his home track debut when he tackled this distance here last start. He was much too good for all except the winner and he is very suitably placed with that performance now behind him. MAGIC MERLIN was competing in blinkers for the first time when he dug deep to score at Muswellbrook. He can be expected to cope when he is now produced over this distance for the first time. ASTROGAZER presents third up, making a Scone debut. He was a third up winner last preparation at Orange and he shouldn't be underestimated here third up either. CALEDONIAN struck traffic problems when he was competing after a four week break at Coffs Harbour. He refused to shirk his task on the day and this quicker back-up will now aid his cause.

raceTips.comment: Feazabeel has to lump weight despite the claim but looks hard to beat back in this grading, noting it's not a strong BM58 either. Barring bad luck in running I'd expect he justifies favouritism. Magic Merlin was a gallant winner last time out which will see him have fans, especially with Mitch Bell retaining the ride. Caledonian is very consistent in this grading, albeit without winning. Astrogazer strips fitter third up, next best.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 4, 10, 11. VITTOZZI kept trying in defeat after she struck traffic problems second up at Gosford. Switching to the country circuit creates scope for improvement here, third up. EXCESSOR begins his second campaign after two recent trials. He's already proven over this trip and the distance should not create a problem for him here first up. IRON FURY handed in an honest front-running Wyong effort last start and a switch back from 1350m aids his cause today.  BY THE WAY was produced second up in her first campaign since a stable change when she stylishly opened her account last start at Moree. She should have more to offer over the same journey this afternoon.

raceTips.comment: Vittozzi found the line well second up in a handy form reference race relative to this and is looking for this longer trip now. Not surprised to see the market gravitate her way. Iron Fury looks ideally suited dropping back in distance and is set to peak. Not Mee had excuses last time out on the back of a win prior. Drawn well and fitter again, she can run much better than pricing suggests. By The Way coming off a last start win is progressive enough to measure up.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 6, 11, 13, 14. OAKFIELD IOWA has been responsible for costly defeats first and second up at Wyong and then at Newcastle. The addition of blinkers will now create the opportunity for her to atone. SWITCH ON must be forgiven for an unplaced debut effort at Warwick Farm when there were excuses. She was immediately spelled and she resumes today after winning the second of her two lead-up trials. She is much better placed here. LIFE'S TURNS performed well above market place expectations here last start after blinkers had been added to his gear. The blinkers remain place today and he can maintain his form without causing a surprise. CHATOYER takes on mostly older opposition on debut today as a three-year-old filly however, after two recent trials with Heavelon Van Der Hoven aboard on both occasions, she shouldn't be underestimated at her first start.

raceTips.comment: Specking Life's Turns at odds. Blinkers went on last time and he was strong late suggesting rising to this distance range will prove highly advantageous. Switch On sparks plenty of interest. Resuming for a second prep off a nice trial and has been well supported early. Oakfield Iowa was good when only finding one better last time out and now gets blinkers on to spark more improvement. Sparkling Fire next.

bestBets.overview: On pace, 1, 5, 6, 7, 10. READY AND LUCKY finished unplaced at Rosehill last start however her effort was better than it appears at face value. She's trialed since and a fifty-one day break can therefore be coped with when she steps back in distance this afternoon. VARUNI was resuming when she handed in quick closing sectionals to score at Muswellbrook first up. She should have more to offer within the same distance range second up. THINK BACK will be making her home track debut first up in her second campaign since a stable change. She trialed earlier in the month at Newcastle on the Beaumont track and this journey should not create any issues for her first up. ERINA was resuming from a very long spell when she became most unsuited in transit last start at her Gosford home base. She will have scope to improve when she now makes a Scone debut. SHAGGY ROGERS did a top job to do all but win at Gilgandra after he struck traffic problems, The addition of a tongue tie can aid his cause here.

raceTips.comment: Ready And Lucky looks hard to beat post let-up, back in distance and with recent form lines. She should be favourite for mine. Varuni does have the upside of a last start win and being so lightly raced so I can't understand the liking. Think Back doesn't have a flash first up record but both wins to date have been when Mikayla Weir has been aboard. Erina next.
